passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.1
passages.text: At tibi Colchorum, memini, regina vacavi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.2
passages.text: Ars mea cum peteres ut tibi ferret opem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.3
passages.text: Tunc quae dispensant mortalia fila sorores

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.4
passages.text: Debuerant fusos evoluisse meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.5
passages.text: Tum potui Medea mori bene! quidquid ab illo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.6
passages.text: Produxi vitam tempore, poena fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.7
passages.text: Ei mihi! cur umquam iuvenalibus acta lacertis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.8
passages.text: Phrixeam petiit Pelias arbor ovem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.9
passages.text: Cur umquam Colchi Magnetida vidimus Argo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.10
passages.text: Turbaque Phasiacam Graia bibistis aquam?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.11
passages.text: Cur mihi plus aequo flavi placuere capilli

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.12
passages.text: Et decor et linguae gratia ficta tuae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.13
passages.text: Aut, semel in nostras quoniam nova puppis harenas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.14
passages.text: Venerat audacis attuleratque viros,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.15
passages.text: Isset anhelatos non praemedicatus in ignes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.16
passages.text: Inmemor Aesonides oraque adusta boum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.17
passages.text: Semina iecisset totidem quot semina et hostes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.18
passages.text: Ut caderet cultu cultor ab ipse suo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.19
passages.text: Quantum perfidiae tecum, scelerate, perisset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.20
passages.text: Dempta forent capiti quam mala multa meo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.21
passages.text: Est aliqua ingrato meritum exprobrare voluptas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.22
passages.text: Hac fruar; haec de te gaudia sola feram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.23
passages.text: Iussus inexpertam Colchos advertere puppim

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.24
passages.text: Intrasti patriae regna beata meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.25
passages.text: Hoc illic Medea fui, nova nupta quod hic est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.26
passages.text: Quam pater est illi, tam mihi dives erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.27
passages.text: Hic Ephyren bimarem, Scythia tenus ille nivosa

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.28
passages.text: Omne tenet, Ponti qua plaga laeva iacet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.29
passages.text: Accipis hospitio iuvenes, Aeeta, Pelasgos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.30
passages.text: Et premitis pictos, corpora Graia, toros.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.31
passages.text: Tunc ego te vidi, tunc coepi scire, quid esses;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.32
passages.text: Illa fuit mentis prima ruina meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.33
passages.text: Et vidi et perii; nec notis ignibus arsi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.34
passages.text: Ardet ut ad magnos pinea taeda deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.35
passages.text: Et formosus eras, et me mea fata trahebant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.36
passages.text: Abstulerant oculi lumina nostra tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.37
passages.text: Perfide, sensisti — quis enim bene celat amorem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.38
passages.text: Eminet indicio prodita flamma suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.39
passages.text: Dicitur interea tibi lex ut dura ferorum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.40
passages.text: Insolito premeres vomere colla boum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.41
passages.text: Martis erant tauri plus quam per cornua saevi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.42
passages.text: Quorum terribilis spiritus ignis erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.43
passages.text: Aere pedes solidi praetentaque naribus aera,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.44
passages.text: Nigra per adflatus haec quoque facta suos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.45
passages.text: Semina praeterea populos genitura iuberis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.46
passages.text: Spargere devota lata per arva manu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.47
passages.text: Qui peterent natis secum tua corpora telis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.48
passages.text: Illa est agricolae messis iniqua suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.49
passages.text: Lumina custodis succumbere nescia somno,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.50
passages.text: Ultimus est aliqua decipere arte labor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.51
passages.text: Dixerat Aeetes; maesti consurgitis omnes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.52
passages.text: Mensaque purpureos deserit alta toros.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.53
passages.text: Quam tibi tunc longe regnum dotale Creusae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.54
passages.text: Et socer et magni nata Creontis erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.55
passages.text: Tristis abis; oculis abeuntem prosequor udis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.56
passages.text: Et dixit tenui murmure lingua: 'vale!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.57
passages.text: Ut positum tetigi thalamo male saucia lectum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.58
passages.text: Acta est per lacrimas nox mihi, quanta fuit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.59
passages.text: Ante oculos taurique meos segetesque nefandae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.60
passages.text: Ante meos oculos pervigil anguis erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.61
passages.text: Hinc amor, hinc timor est; ipsum timor auget amorem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.62
passages.text: Mane erat, et thalamo cara recepta soror

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.63
passages.text: Disiectamque comas adversaque in ora iacentem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.64
passages.text: Invenit, et lacrimis omnia plena meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.65
passages.text: Orat opem Minyis. alter petit, impetrat alter:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.66
passages.text: Aesonio iuveni quod rogat illa, damus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.67
passages.text: Est nemus et piceis et frondibus ilicis atrum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.68
passages.text: Vix illuc radiis solis adire licet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.69
passages.text: Sunt in eo — fuerant certe — delubra Dianae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.70
passages.text: Aurea barbarica stat dea facta manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.71
passages.text: Noscis? an exciderunt mecum loca? venimus illuc.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.72
passages.text: Orsus es infido sic prior ore loqui:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.73
passages.text: 'Ius tibi et arbitrium nostrae fortuna salutis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.74
passages.text: Tradidit, inque tua est vitaque morsque manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.75
passages.text: Perdere posse sat est, siquem iuvet ipsa potestas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.76
passages.text: Sed tibi servatus gloria maior ero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.77
passages.text: Per mala nostra precor, quorum potes esse levamen,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.78
passages.text: Per genus, et numen cuncta videntis avi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.79
passages.text: Per triplicis vultus arcanaque sacra Dianae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.80
passages.text: Et si forte aliquos gens habet ista deos —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.81
passages.text: O virgo, miserere mei, miserere meorum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.82
passages.text: Effice me meritis tempus in omne tuum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.83
passages.text: Quodsi forte virum non dedignare Pelasgum —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.84
passages.text: Sed mihi tam faciles unde meosque deos? —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.85
passages.text: Spiritus ante meus tenues vanescet in auras

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.86
passages.text: Quam thalamo nisi tu nupta sit ulla meo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.87
passages.text: Conscia sit Iuno sacris praefecta maritis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.88
passages.text: Et dea marmorea cuius in aede sumus!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.89
passages.text: Haec animum — et quota pars haec sunt! — movere puellae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.90
passages.text: Simplicis, et dextrae dextera iuncta meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.91
passages.text: Vidi etiam lacrimas — sua pars et fraudis in illis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.92
passages.text: Sic cito sum verbis capta puella tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.93
passages.text: Iungis aenipedes inadusto corpore tauros

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.94
passages.text: Et solidam iusso vomere findis humum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.95
passages.text: Arva venenatis pro semine dentibus inples,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.96
passages.text: Nascitur et gladios scutaque miles habens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.97
passages.text: Ipsa ego, quae dederam medicamina, pallida sedi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.98
passages.text: Cum vidi subitos arma tenere viros,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.99
passages.text: Donec terrigenae, facinus mirabile, fratres

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.100
passages.text: Inter se strictas conseruere manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.101
passages.text: Insopor ecce vigil squamis crepitantibus horrens

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.102
passages.text: Sibilat et torto pectore verrit humum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.105
passages.text: Illa ego, quae tibi sum nunc denique barbara facta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.106
passages.text: Nunc tibi sum pauper, nunc tibi visa nocens,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.107
passages.text: Flammea subduxi medicato lumina somno,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.108
passages.text: Et tibi, quae raperes, vellera tuta dedi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.109
passages.text: Proditus est genitor, regnum patriamque reliqui;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.110
passages.text: Munus, in exilio quod licet esse, tuli!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.111
passages.text: Virginitas facta est peregrini praeda latronis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.112
passages.text: Optima cum cara matre relicta soror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.113
passages.text: At non te fugiens sine me, germane, reliqui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.114
passages.text: Deficit hoc uno littera nostra loco.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.115
passages.text: Quod facere ausa mea est, non audet scribere dextra.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.116
passages.text: Sic ego, sed tecum, dilaceranda fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.117
passages.text: Nec tamen extimui — quid enim post illa timerem? —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.118
passages.text: Credere me pelago, femina iamque nocens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.119
passages.text: Numen ubi est? ubi di? meritas subeamus in alto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.120
passages.text: Tu fraudis poenas, credulitatis ego!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.121
passages.text: Compressos utinam Symplegades elisissent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.122
passages.text: Nostraque adhaererent ossibus ossa tuis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.123
passages.text: Aut nos Scylla rapax canibus mersisset edendos —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.124
passages.text: Debuit ingratis Scylla nocere viris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.125
passages.text: Quaeque vomit totidem fluctus totidemque resorbet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.126
passages.text: Nos quoque Trinacriae supposuisset aquae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.127
passages.text: Sospes ad Haemonias victorque reverteris urbes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.128
passages.text: Ponitur ad patrios aurea lana deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.129
passages.text: Quid referam Peliae natas pietate nocentes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.130
passages.text: Caesaque virginea membra paterna manu?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.131
passages.text: Ut culpent alii, tibi me laudare necesse est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.132
passages.text: Pro quo sum totiens esse coacta nocens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.133
passages.text: Ausus es — o, iusto desunt sua verba dolori! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.134
passages.text: Ausus es 'Aesonia,' dicere, 'cede domo!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.135
passages.text: Iussa domo cessi natis comitata duobus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.136
passages.text: Et, qui me sequitur semper, amore tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.137
passages.text: Ut subito nostras Hymen cantatus ad aures

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.138
passages.text: Venit, et accenso lampades igne micant,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.139
passages.text: Tibiaque effundit socialia carmina vobis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.140
passages.text: At mihi funerea flebiliora tuba,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.141
passages.text: Pertimui, nec adhuc tantum scelus esse putabam;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.142
passages.text: Sed tamen in toto pectore frigus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.143
passages.text: Turba ruunt et 'Hymen,' clamant, 'Hymenaee!' frequenter —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.144
passages.text: Quo propior vox haec, hoc mihi peius erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.145
passages.text: Diversi flebant servi lacrimasque tegebant —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.146
passages.text: Quis vellet tanti nuntius esse mali?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.147
passages.text: Me quoque, quidquid erat, potius nescire iuvabat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.148
passages.text: Sed tamquam scirem, mens mea tristis erat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.149
passages.text: Cum minor e pueris (casu studione videndi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.150
passages.text: Constitit ad geminae limina prima foris)

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.151
passages.text: 'Huc modo, mater, adi! pompam pater,' inquit, 'Iason

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.152
passages.text: Ducit et adiunctos aureus urget equos!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.153
passages.text: Protinus abscissa planxi mea pectora veste,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.154
passages.text: Tuta nec a digitis ora fuere meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.155
passages.text: Ire animus mediae suadebat in agmina turbae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.156
passages.text: Sertaque conpositis demere rapta comis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.157
passages.text: Vix me continui, quin dilaniata capillos

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.158
passages.text: Clamarem 'meus est!' iniceremque manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.159
passages.text: Laese pater, gaude! Colchi gaudete relicti!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.160
passages.text: Inferias umbrae fratris habete mei;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.161
passages.text: Deseror amissis regno patriaque domoque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.162
passages.text: Coniuge, qui nobis omnia solus erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.163
passages.text: Serpentis igitur potui taurosque furentes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.164
passages.text: Unum non potui perdomuisse virum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.165
passages.text: Quaeque feros pepuli doctis medicatibus ignes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.166
passages.text: Non valeo flammas effugere ipsa meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.167
passages.text: Ipsi me cantus herbaeque artesque relinquunt;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.168
passages.text: Nil dea, nil Hecates sacra potentis agunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.169
passages.text: Non mihi grata dies; noctes vigilantur amarae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.170
passages.text: Et tener a misero pectore somnus abest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.171
passages.text: Quae me non possum, potui sopire draconem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.172
passages.text: Utilior cuivis quam mihi cura mea est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.173
passages.text: Quos ego servavi, paelex amplectitur artus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.174
passages.text: Et nostri fructus illa laboris habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.175
passages.text: Forsitan et, stultae dum te iactare maritae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.176
passages.text: Quaeris et iniustis auribus apta loqui,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.177
passages.text: In faciem moresque meos nova crimina fingas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.178
passages.text: Rideat et vitiis laeta sit illa meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.179
passages.text: Rideat et Tyrio iaceat sublimis in ostro —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.180
passages.text: Flebit et ardores vincet adusta meos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.181
passages.text: Dum ferrum flammaeque aderunt sucusque veneni,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.182
passages.text: Hostis Medeae nullus inultus erit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.183
passages.text: Quodsi forte preces praecordia ferrea tangunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.184
passages.text: Nunc animis audi verba minora meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.185
passages.text: Tam tibi sum supplex, quam tu mihi saepe fuisti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.186
passages.text: Nec moror ante tuos procubuisse pedes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.187
passages.text: Si tibi sum vilis, communis respice natos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.188
passages.text: Saeviet in partus dira noverca meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.189
passages.text: Et nimium similes tibi sunt, et imagine tangor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.190
passages.text: Et quotiens video, lumina nostra madent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.191
passages.text: Per superos oro, per avitae lumina flammae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.192
passages.text: Per meritum et natos, pignora nostra, duos —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.193
passages.text: Redde torum, pro quo tot res insana reliqui;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.194
passages.text: Adde fidem dictis auxiliumque refer!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.195
passages.text: Non ego te inploro contra taurosque virosque,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.196
passages.text: Utque tua serpens victa quiescat ope;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.197
passages.text: Te peto, quem merui, quem nobis ipse dedisti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.198
passages.text: Cum quo sum pariter facta parente parens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.199
passages.text: Dos ubi sit, quaeris? campo numeravimus illo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.200
passages.text: Qui tibi laturo vellus arandus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.201
passages.text: Aureus ille aries villo spectabilis alto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.202
passages.text: Dos mea, quam, dicam si tibi 'redde!,' neges.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.203
passages.text: Dos mea tu sospes; dos est mea Graia iuventus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.204
passages.text: I nunc, Sisyphias, inprobe, confer opes!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.205
passages.text: Quod vivis, quod habes nuptam socerumque potentis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.206
passages.text: Hoc ipsum, ingratus quod potes esse, meum est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.207
passages.text: Quos equidem actutum — sed quid praedicere poenam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.208
passages.text: Attinet? ingentis parturit ira minas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.209
passages.text: Quo feret ira, sequar! facti fortasse pigebit —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.210
passages.text: Et piget infido consuluisse viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.211
passages.text: Viderit ista deus, qui nunc mea pectora versat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 12.212
passages.text: Nescio quid certe mens mea maius agit!
